properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 31 at 4:45AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 445 AM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Segundo, or 20 miles west of Trinidad, moving southeast at 5 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Segundo and Weston.
